image_description: A yellow and beige two-seater golf cart parked indoors on a concrete floor. The vehicle features a cream-colored hardtop roof, a black tubular frame, a split windshield, and a rear cargo rack. The interior has beige bench seating and a visible steering wheel. The background shows a garage or workshop setting with shelves and equipment.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific model and class identity against ImageNet standards.
To verify the structural integrity of the tubular frame and ensure no melting into the complex background.
To check for edge bleeding between the dark tires/roof and the lighter background/floor.
There is visible text/logo on the front bumper that needs verification for gibberish or artifacts.
To assess overall sharpness and detect any subtle texture anomalies in the plastic bodywork.

focus_areas: Structural connectivity of the black tubular frame to the body chassis.
Geometric correctness of the steering wheel and dashboard perspective.
Clarity and legibility of the text/logo on the front bumper.
Boundary sharpness between the tires and the concrete floor.
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the text on the front bumper; AI often fails here. Also, verify that the tubular frame connects logically to the chassis without floating or merging incorrectly. Check if the reflection on the windshield is consistent with the indoor lighting environment.
